bugs_found.bug: The 'Sign in with Google' button does not perform OAuth. It opens a simulated account chooser in the UI; the user types ANY email address and the page calls window.postMessage({type:'OAUTH_AUTH_SUCCESS', user:{email, name, role:'ADMIN'}}, '*'). lib/auth.tsx listens for that message and mints a CLIENT-SIDE mock JWT with signature literally 'dummy_signature', then stores it in localStorage as access_token. The code comment states: 'In a real app, we would receive a real JWT token here. For this demo, we'll simulate a token.'
bugs_found.impact: Anyone can authenticate as any email with ADMIN role. Entering 'accts.pak@gmail.com' grants SUPER_ADMIN (hardcoded comparison in lib/auth.tsx). No password, no OAuth, no server verification. The token is unsigned, so any role can also be forged by editing localStorage directly.
bugs_found.additional: window.postMessage uses target origin '*'. The real OAuth implementation exists in server.js (/api/auth/google/url, /auth/google/callback) but Login.tsx never calls it, and /auth/google/callback returns HTTP 404 on the live site.

bugs_found.bug: Signing in with support@taleem360.online triggers an alert telling the visitor that account is suspended and to contact accts.pak@gmail.com. This exposes the owner's personal Gmail address to any visitor and reads as an internal note left in production.

City pages rendered real school brands (Beaconhouse, Army Public School, Allied School, The City School, Lahore Grammar School, Root Millennium, Fazaia Inter College, Edwardes College, St. Francis Grammar School, Pinnacle STEM Academy, Al-Murtaza, Siddique Public, LaSalle High, Muslim College) under the heading 'Trusted by Premier <city> Campuses', footnoted 'Local references are verified partner institutions using the Taleem360 cloud database system.' Taleem360 has no such partnerships.
